inspectionOrder: own source metadata and saved native collection
independence: Recorded before reading main-body handoff, other-object aesthetic criteria or editor rationale.
original: The source reads as a pale cyan block over a small dark intake with three narrow guards and a bright yellow lower lip. Its largely empty upper rectangle overwhelms the functional opening.

Hard chamfered corners, plain slab construction and almost uniform bright cyan top/front areas make the object feel less crafted than the style reference. The guards are legible in this S image but thin relative to the heavy lip.

The saved native collection has six mesh pieces plus a root, with four animated owners and eight saved native actions. These counts describe the source, not restrictions on a better native reconstruction.
target: The selected target supplies a thick rounded pale cyan rim and a visible interior, a separate dark inset guard surround, three substantial metallic bars, softly rounded yellow base and selective inset panels and fasteners.

Broad gentle gradients and warm edge transitions separate blue enamel, gray structural metal, dark recess and yellow protective base. The form has substantially more depth and useful construction hierarchy than the source.

Target highlights and small silver hardware are visibly stronger than the plant reference. Preserve volume and material separation with gentle symmetric illumination; avoid copying bright white hot strips, edge halos, specks, or tiny details that disappear at game scale.
The target is a one-view design guide and does not certify the native rear seat, camera, mouth location, all-facing coherence, exact proportions or safe animation.
desiredOutcomes: A compact collector with rounded crafted volumes, a visibly recessed functional mouth and a coherent cyan/gray/dark/yellow material hierarchy.
Soft warm gradients and restrained non-directional reflections reveal depth without flat white plates, black dead spots or harsh specular streaks.
Purposeful construction details survive as broad readable shapes at logical and phone scale; rear and side views receive equally resolved native construction.
Idle and active are visibly distinguishable through a functional collector gesture using native geometry; every view remains free of clipping, merged guards, detached parts or frame jitter.
limits: Native action values, evaluated bounds, loop closure, mounted rear contact, body lamp clearance and consumer evidence remain to be audited after this independent baseline. Original source-inspection matrices are initial loaded values; evaluated geometry audit follows.
